atlases.a:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Batch 63 Atlas A, a single square 3x3 sheet of nine white UI glyph revisions.
The supplied 3x3 reference sheet contains the GM's EXACT selected candidates in the SAME row-major order. Revise each corresponding glyph according to its instruction below. Preserve its subject and useful broad silhouette unless a complete redesign is requested.
FORMAT: exactly nine equal square cells, strict 3 rows by 3 columns. One centered independent icon per cell. Give every cell at least 15% empty margin on every side, including the tops of ears and raised hands. No grid, labels, text, logos, borders or watermark.
RENDERING: pure solid WHITE #FFFFFF shapes on a pure solid BLACK #000000 background. Minimal flat stencil silhouettes, broad negative-space cutouts, dnd5e UI simplicity, readable at 16/24/32px. No shading, gradients, wear, grunge, scratches, speckles, hatching or tiny detached marks. Do not replicate noise or distress from the references. Avoid extra objects and floating decorative symbols.
ROW-MAJOR REVISIONS:
1. handel_revision_b: Two opposing hands at different heights: the upper hand from the left gives one wrapped bundle to the right, while the lower hand from the right gives one plain crate to the left. Each hand must hold a different exchanged object.
2. bebeszenie_revision_b: Exactly TWO tools form an X: a butcher knife on one diagonal and recognisable pliers with two open jaws and two handles on the other. Replace the unidentified extra tool with the pliers. A restrained three-rib carcass outline stays behind them; no third tool and no gore.
3. szabrowanie_revision_b: A crowbar levers open a crate: rotate it so its curved working tip is visibly inserted at the front lip of the crate, the fulcrum rests on the rim, and its long handle extends up-left. The lid is a large, clearly separate slab raised behind the crate, not a narrow stick.
4. zabawka_revision_b: Preserve the existing teddy bear; zoom out enough that both rounded ears are complete and separated from the top edge. Keep all limbs, broad eye cutouts and simple toy form. No cropped ears.
5. szlachetne_urodzenie_revision_b: Preserve the survivor and signet-ring gesture but replace the ragged coat with a brand-new respectable formal coat: intact smooth hem, crisp lapels and cuffs, clean symmetrical tailoring, no tears or wear.
6. czlowiek_aligator_revision_b: Preserve the human swimmer and broad wake. Remove the alligator tail entirely from the right; no animal parts. One complete human performing a crawl stroke above a single water contour.
7. wloczykij_revision_b: Preserve the rugged boot, reed marsh and sand dune. Remove the strapped rolled map completely; no cylindrical roll or straps above the ankle. Keep the boot silhouette legible.
8. polegam_tylko_na_sobie_revision_b: Completely replace the forging scene with one lone rugged man standing among sparse desolation: a low broken wall, one dead tree stump and a barren ground contour. The isolated human silhouette dominates; no anvil, hammer or crafting tools.
9. nowka_sztuka_revision_b: Rework the opened bunker equipment crate so one large rectangular hinged lid is unmistakably raised BEHIND the box, with broad empty interior space and one pristine pistol partly visible inside. The lid is one complete slab with readable hinge relationship, never two side flanges.
Count the objects and hands carefully. In glyph 2 there are only a knife and pliers, in glyph 9 the raised lid is one large coherent rectangle. Preserve all nine positions.
atlases.b:
Use case: stylized-concept. Batch 63 Atlas B — four exact-reference revisions and five new white interface icons.
REFERENCE: the supplied reference sheet's cells 1-4 are the GM's EXACT selected candidates for the matching subjects. Revise those four according to the instructions. The other reference cells are intentionally blank; invent the five NEW specified glyphs there. Take simplicity and solid-white glyph style from the supplied style atlas, not its subjects. Do not preserve fine texture from any reference.
Generate ONE complete square 3x3 atlas, exactly nine equal cells in row-major order, one independent centered white glyph per cell. All glyphs have at least 15% blank margin on every side. Pure solid WHITE #FFFFFF on pure BLACK #000000, minimal flat stencil silhouettes, dnd5e interface style. Broad intact joined shapes and restrained negative space, legible at 16/24/32px. Absolutely no text, letters, numerals, labels, borders, grid lines, logos, shading, gradients, distress, grunge, scratches, hatching, tiny specks or decorative symbols. No gore.
ROW-MAJOR SUBJECTS:
1. ruch_revision_d — REVISION: Preserve the saved colossal organic crocodilian moving forward. Replace armadillo-like scales with a few broad irregular crocodile scutes along the back; strong crocodilian head, feet and long tail, no artificial segmented armour. Add three broad backward speed streaks indicating forward movement. A crushed car establishes size.
2. paszcza_revision_c — REVISION: An immense open crocodilian jaw surrounds one unmistakable complete HUMAN silhouette. The human's head, torso, two arms pushing the jaws apart and two separated bent legs must all read clearly in broad negative space. Enlarge the human relative to the mouth; do not merge the body into teeth or jaw edges. No gore.
3. wychuchana_spluwa_revision_c — REVISION: Exactly TWO gloved hands total, no extra fingers that resemble hands: the left hand grips one pistol by its grip, the right hand holds one broad cleaning cloth against its slide. Each hand attaches to one visible wrist at opposite sides. Show careful gun cleaning with only pistol, two hands and cloth.
4. samuraj_revision_b — REVISION: Completely redraw as a clear practical blade-draw gesture: the left hand holds one straight scabbard horizontally at the waist; the right hand pulls one slim single-edged blade diagonally up-right, with much of the blade visibly clear of the scabbard. Exactly two hands, one blade, one scabbard. No armoured figure, helmet or busy ornaments.
5. kwas-w-zylach — NEW: One sturdy forearm with one bold vein contour deflects two corrosive drops against a small plain shield. Poison/acid resistance, no spilled gore.
6. chodzmy-na-pewno-juz-utonal — NEW: One human swimmer stays below a single waterline, cheeks holding breath, with one broad air bubble above the face. Show prolonged underwater endurance without a drowning victim.
7. edukacja — NEW: One open prewar technical book, one broad medical cross on one page and a simple wrench diagram on the other. Large functional shapes only; no writing.
8. gambling-we-krwi — NEW: One confident barter trader offers a practical canteen from a crate with an open hand. A second hand indicates more goods inside; no coins, dice, cards or cash. Emphasise tireless barter and trade access.
9. zjadlem-wlasnego-psa — NEW: One intimidating rugged butcher in an apron grips a broad cleaver at his side; hard square shoulders and a stern plain face. No dog, carcass, gore or comic grin.
Important: glyph 2 needs one complete readable human body with head, TWO arms and TWO legs, surrounded by jaws with broad open space. Glyph 3 contains exactly TWO hands attached to TWO wrists, one pistol and one cloth. Glyph 4 contains exactly two hands, one blade and one scabbard. Glyph 8 means BARTER, not casino gambling.
atlases.c:
Use case: stylized-concept. Batch 63 Atlas C — nine NEW feature UI glyphs.
The supplied atlas is STYLE ONLY: match its solid-white silhouettes, broad negative-space details and practical dnd5e interface simplicity. Do not copy any of its subjects.
Generate ONE complete square 3x3 atlas, exactly nine equal cells in row-major order, one independent centered white glyph per cell. All glyphs have at least 15% blank margin on every side. Pure solid WHITE #FFFFFF on pure BLACK #000000, minimal flat stencil silhouettes, dnd5e interface style. Broad intact joined shapes and restrained negative space, legible at 16/24/32px. Absolutely no text, letters, numerals, labels, borders, grid lines, logos, shading, gradients, distress, grunge, scratches, hatching, tiny specks or decorative symbols. No gore.
ROW-MAJOR SUBJECTS:
1. Hi-Tech: One gloved finger confidently presses a large control on a compact electronic console with three broad circuit traces and two plain buttons. No text or tiny screen detail.
2. Moloch? Coś słyszałem: One alert survivor crouches behind a thick barrier while inspecting a simple machine-head schematic on a broad handheld board. A single blast contour stays beyond the barrier; knowledge and defensive awareness.
3. Cholerny kaznodzieja: One forceful preacher in a plain long coat raises an open hand while holding a simple closed book in the other. Strong speech posture, no religious logo, lettering or floating symbols.
4. Przed wojną wszystko było lepiej: One elderly survivor holds an intact open medical manual beside a simple prewar building silhouette on its page. Broad shapes, no writing or nostalgia badges.
5. Człowiek zwany koniem: One calm human hand holds the reins close to a strong horse's head, with a gentle bandage on the animal's neck. Emphasise handling and care, not a fantasy centaur.
6. Zdrowa okolica: One healthy broad-chested survivor stands firm beneath a large clean rising sun, with one plain shield shape along the torso. Constitution and resilience, no fragile tiny plus marks.
7. Hazardzista: One sly hand palms a single playing card behind a fan of two visible cards. One large plain diamond shape only; sleight of hand and deception, no ranks or lettering.
8. Aramis: Two practical fencing blades meet as one broad opponent hand loses its grip on a sword, which clearly falls away. A forceful clean disarming action, no arrows or musketeer portrait.
9. Aspiryna i Miętusy: One field medic's two hands wrap a broad bandage on a large forearm beside an obviously open empty medicine case. Treatment despite lack of supplies; no scattered pills, writing or gore.
Every subject must be immediately distinguishable at inventory size. Keep scenes sparse and show practical objects or gestures; no busy pictograms, tiny words or badges.

targetedCorrections.reason: The first atlas draft omitted the hand holding the scabbard.
targetedCorrections.prompt:
Edit the supplied minimal white blade-draw glyph. The current draft has only ONE hand; fix that failure.
Create ONE simple centered UI glyph on a pure solid BLACK #000000 square background with pure solid WHITE #FFFFFF stencil shapes. Match its simplicity, crisp edges and broad negative space; no gradients, shading, distress, grunge, tiny lines, lettering, logos or other objects.
MUST SHOW EXACTLY TWO DISTINCT HANDS, each attached to a cuff and wrist:
- On the RIGHT, one right hand grips the sword's HILT and draws the blade diagonally up-right.
- On the LEFT, one left hand clearly wraps around the mouth of the SCABBARD and holds the scabbard diagonally down-left. Its fingers and thumb must be recognisable and separated by broad black cutouts.
One blade, one plain hilt, one scabbard, TWO complete hands. The blade is partly drawn, aligned with the scabbard opening. Do not replace the left hand with a sleeve, ring or floating cylinder. Do not add a third hand.
Keep the whole gesture compact and readable at 16px; reserve at least 18% empty margin around the full subject. Remove the fine motion streaks so the two functional grips are the focus. No figure, no armour, no scenery.
